claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any model/spec label or sensor information.
Photo 0 does not show the camera model or any performance spec screen.

risks.risk: Exact Canon model is not identifiable from the photo, so the claimed 18MP/8fps specs may not match the actual body.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number on the camera body (e.g., on the top plate or front panel) and the back screen showing the menu 'About/Model'.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Canon APS-C body with unknown/possibly lower performance; treat claimed high specs as not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Condition risk (sensor/mirror/shutter/controls) cannot be assessed from a single front-angle photo.
risks.proof: Short video clip showing: power on, autofocus, menu navigation, and a playback shot; plus a photo of the sensor area (mirror up) or a test image for dust/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for functionality: assume it may need service or has untested faults.

risks.risk: Lens/mount compatibility risk: the photo shows the body front, but no lens is shown; buyer may need a lens separately.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens mount contacts and confirmation whether a lens is included (and which lens model if included).

risks.risk: Battery/charger/accessories risk: not shown whether battery, charger, strap, and memory card are included.
risks.proof: Photos of all included items laid out (battery, charger, cables, strap, memory card).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal accessories (battery/charger not guaranteed).

proof_requests: Photo showing the exact Canon model name/number on the body (top/front/back) and/or the 'About' page on the LCD.
Power-on video clip: menu open/close, autofocus attempt, and a quick photo playback.
Photo of the sensor area (mirror up) or a test image to check for dust/fungus/scratches.
Confirm whether it is body-only or includes a lens; if lens included, show lens model.
Photos of included accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card).
response.reason: The photo confirms only that it is a Canon camera body, but the exact model (needed to price correctly and verify the 18MP/8fps claims) is not readable. Request model identification and basic functionality proof before pricing.
